# Manage Accounts

You can access what you need in your Members account at Manage.STAFDA.org
When you click on the links below, you will be redirected to the new Manage.STAFDA.org website. For your security, you will be asked to re-enter your username & password.

PAY DUES

Please click the button above to pay your annual STAFDA dues invoice.

For assistance with paying dues, Members can contact Cathy Usher at cusher@stafda.org

MANAGE COMPANY

Manage Company is only available to your company’s Key Contact who has been setup to manage the members within your company. Your company’s Key Contact can add or remove other employee users as well as update passwords.

For assistance with Manage Company account, your company’s Key Contact can email Cathy Usher at cusher@stafda.org

UPDATE PASSWORD

Update Password is ONLY available to Members who have previously been set up with a username & password.

For assistance with updating password or if you do not have a username or password set up yet, please contact Cathy Usher at cusher@stafda.org

Our tools, resources and community will help save you time, save you money and make your business better. NGA recognizes the value that your company brings to the glass and glazing industry, and we want you as a member!

### Membership Dues

Regular members are companies who are actively engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation, distribution, fabrication, replacement or repair of glass and glazing industry products. Affiliate members are companies who have a professional interest in the glass and glazing industry such as architects, engineers and consultants.

#### 

Regular Member

Membership is company based. Dues are based on your company's global gross annual sales in glass and glass-related products. Members are required to pay the highest dues for which they qualify.

Annual dues based on your company’s gross annual sales, per the chart below.

Annual Sales – Annual Dues

Under $1 million - $395

$1-2 million - $695

$2-3 million - $1,015 

$3-5 million - $1,365

$5-10 million - $1,855

$10-20 million - $2,765

$20-50 million - $3,845

$50-100 million- $6,160

$100-500 million - $9,830

$500 million+ - $11,615

Member companies can add additional or subsidiary locations to their membership to receive the same NGA benefits, but should factor each location's revenue in to their Annual Sales amount. Please contact membership@glass.org or 703-442-4890, ext. 127 for assistance.

#### 

Affiliate Member

Membership is company based. Consultants, architects and engineers are considered Affiliate members and have a flat annual dues rate.

Annual dues - $530

Join NGA Today!

Have questions? Contact Brian Peters, Senior Director of Membership & Industry Programs, by EMAIL (brian.peters@ascouncil.org).

Join as Supplier

### Affiliate

Affiliate Member is one of the following:

  * Service Supplier -- a market research or technical consultant affiliated with and works in the North American adhesives and sealants industry
  * Distributor -- a company that buys and resells finished adhesives, sealants and/or application equipment to North American-based end-users
  * Affiliate Manufacturer -- a company that manufactures and sells adhesives and/or sealants globally, but maintains all sales and manufacturing operations OUTSIDE of North America
  * Affiliate Supplier -- a company that supplies raw materials to the industry globally but maintains all sales and manufacturing operations OUTSIDE of North America

Have questions? Contact Brian Peters, Senior Director of Membership & Industry Programs, by EMAIL (brian.peters@ascouncil.org).

Join as Affiliate

NGA members can save up to 26% off UPS Express air and international shipments. That's a significant savings over FedEx published rates! Shipping with a leader in the transportation industry has never been easier or more cost efficient.

UPS Freight offers a large portfolio of services to meet all of your shipping needs.

  * Regional, interregional and long-haul capabilities
  * Service to and from Canada and Mexico
  * Trade show services
  * Innovative technology

The UPS Freight Savings Program is free with no minimum shipping requirements. To enroll and obtain your NGA promo code, simply call 703/442-4890 ext. 127 or email membership@glass.org.
